purpose: Execute the atomic split-body-with-plane operation within the MA-23 boundary: Transient in-place plane split only. It does not attach, call SeparatePieces, or accept an attached DesignBody/component occurrence.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires split-body-with-plane and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Closed nonempty transient body to split in place.

inputs.name: plane
inputs.description: Dividing plane supplied directly to Body.Split.

preconditions: plane is a valid dividing plane and volume_tolerance_mm3 is finite/nonnegative.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {body: transient Modeler.Body, piece_count: integer}; the body remains a disjoint-piece container unless the caller separately separates pieces.

postconditions: The returned body passes assert_closed and reports the resulting piece_count.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic split-body-with-plane operation within the MA-23 boundary: Transient in-place plane split only. It does not attach, call SeparatePieces, or accept an attached DesignBody/component occurrence. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: No document selection is performed inside this action; supplied references are validated directly.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No separate-piece refresh is performed; callers must treat prior topology references as stale.

failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

failure_modes.condition: Split raises or volume/assert_closed checks fail.
failure_modes.detection: Split raises or volume/assert_closed checks fail.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use and retain only a clean run-owned state.

recovery.action: Discard the unchanged/partially mutated transient and supply a plane that crosses it.
Discard the transient body and rerun from a fresh copy; no rollback is implemented.
